nodes.label: XTAL
nodes.tooltip: Click to edit the XTAL frequency.

nodes.label: PLL
nodes.tooltip: PLL output frequency must be between 960 MHz and 2400 MHz.

nodes.label: PLL1P
nodes.tooltip: PLL1P output frequency must be between 60 MHz and 1200 MHz.

nodes.label: PLL1Q
nodes.tooltip: PLL1Q output frequency must be between 106.6 MHz and 1200 MHz.

nodes.label: PLL1R
nodes.tooltip: PLL1R output frequency must be between 106.6 MHz and 1200 MHz.

nodes.label: PLL2
nodes.tooltip: PLL 2 output frequency must be between 960 MHz and 2400 MHz.

nodes.label: PLL2P
nodes.tooltip: PLL2P output frequency must be between 60 MHz and 1200 MHz.

nodes.label: PLL2Q
nodes.tooltip: PLL2Q output frequency must be between 106.6 MHz and 1200 MHz.

nodes.label: PLL2R
nodes.tooltip: PLL2R output frequency must be between 106.6 MHz and 1200 MHz.

nodes.label: CPUCLK
nodes.tooltip:
The CPU0 clock (CPUCLK) is used as the operating clock of the CPU0. 
Maximum frequency is 1 GHz.

nodes.label: CPUCLK1
nodes.tooltip:
The CPU clock 1 (CPUCLK1) is used as the operating clock of the CPU1. 
Maximum frequency is 250 MHz.

nodes.label: MRICLK
nodes.tooltip:
The MRAM code bus clock (MRICLK) is used as the operating clock for the MRAM code bus interface. 
Maximum frequency is 250 MHz.

nodes.label: ICLK
nodes.tooltip:
The system clock (ICLK) is used as the operating clock of the DMAC, DTC, SRAM, System Bus, I/O Port, ICU and DRW. 
Maximum frequency is 250 MHz.

nodes.label: PCLKA
nodes.tooltip: The Peripheral clock A (PCLKA) is used as the operating clock for the ESWM, SCI, I3C, CANFD, CNECC, SPI, CRC, DOC, RSIP-E50D, GPT, DOTF AES clock, ADC16H, PDG, USBHS, CEU. Maximum frequency is 125 MHz.

nodes.label: PCLKB
nodes.tooltip:
The Peripheral clock B (PCLKB) is used as the operating clock for the CAC, ELC, POEG, RTC, WDT, IWDT, AGT, ULPT, IIC, USBFS, SSIE, SDHI, TSN, ACMPHS, OSPI, DOTF bus clock, DAC12, PDMIF. 
Maximum frequency is 62.5 MHz.

nodes.label: PCLKC
nodes.tooltip:
The Peripheral clock C (PCLKC) is unused and should match PCLKA. 
Maximum frequency is 125 MHz.

nodes.label: PCLKD
nodes.tooltip:
The Peripheral clock D (PCLKD) is used as the operating clock for the GPT (count clock) module and PDG. 
Maximum frequency is 250 MHz.

nodes.label: PCLKE
nodes.tooltip:
The Peripheral clock E (PCLKE) is used as the operating clock for the  CANFDRAM. 
Maximum frequency is 250 MHz.

nodes.label: BCLK
nodes.tooltip:
The external bus clock (BCLK) is an operating clock for the external bus controller.
It is also output externally from the BCLK pin for the external connection bus. 
Maximum frequency is 125 MHz.

nodes.label: CLKOUT
nodes.tooltip:
Frequency output on the CLKOUT pin if CLKOUT is enabled. 
Maximum frequency is 60 MHz.

nodes.label: SCICLK
nodes.tooltip:
The SCI clock (SCICLK) is an operating clock for the SCI module. 
Maximum frequency is 120MHz.

nodes.label: SPICLK
nodes.tooltip:
The SPI clock (SPICLK) is an operating clock for the SPI module. 
Maximum frequency is 333.33MHz.

nodes.label: I3CCLK
nodes.tooltip:
The I3C clock (I3CCLK) is an operating clock for the I3C module. 
Maximum frequency is 200MHz.

nodes.label: ADCCLK
nodes.tooltip:
The ADC clock (ADCCLK) is an operating clock for the ADC module. 
Maximum frequency is 120MHz.

constraints.message: The system clock source must be greater than 0.
CPUCLK must not be less than ICLK
CPUCLK must be less than or equal to 960MHz when using HOCO as source for PLL
CPUCLK1 must not be less than ICLK
MRICLK must not be less than ICLK
CPUCLK must not be less than MRICLK
CPUCLK1 must not be less than MRICLK
ICLK must not be less than PCLKA or PCLKB
ICLK must not be less than BCLK
PCLKA must not be less than PCLKB
PCLKD must not be less than PCLKA or PCLKB
The I3CCLK frequency must meet the following constraint: I3CCLK / 2 <= PCLKA <= I3CCLK
Maximum allowed XTAL frequency is 48MHz
PLL Reference Clock after divider must be between 8 and 24 MHz
PLL2 Reference Clock after divider must be between 8 and 24 MHz
The frequency of ADCCLK must be set so that PCLKA >= ADCLK

constraints.expr: (f.adcclk_display == 0) || (f.pclka_display / f.pclkc_display == 1) || (f.pclka_display / f.pclkc_display == 2) || (f.pclka_display / f.pclkc_display == 4) || (f.pclka_display / f.pclkc_display == 8) || (f.pclkc_display / f.pclka_display == 2) || (f.pclkc_display / f.pclka_display == 4)
constraints.message: If the A/D converter is enabled, the clock frequency ratio is constrained as follows: PCLKA:PCLKC = 1:1 or 2:1 or 4:1 or 8:1 or 1:2 or 1:4
The input clock (before divider) for the System Clock must be less than or equal to 1 GHz.
The input clock (before divider) for SCICLK must be less than or equal to 480 MHz.
The input clock (before divider) for SPICLK must be less than or equal to 333.333333 MHz.
The input clock (before divider) for ADCCLK must be less than or equal to 480 MHz.
The input clock (before divider) for I3CCLK must be less than or equal to 800 MHz.
